title: Mars Announces Cheez-It, Club and Pringles as the Official Salty Snacks Providers and Proud Supporters of LA28 and Team USA - LA 2028
summary: Mars Announces Cheez-It, Club and Pringles as the Official Salty Snacks Providers and Proud Supporters of LA28 and Team USA LA 2028
ai_summary: Mars announces Cheez-It, Club, and Pringles as the official salty snacks providers and proud supporters of LA28 and Team USA. The announcement highlights the partnership with the upcoming Olympic Games and national team.
